_readme: Curated opening hours for POIs OpenStreetMap doesn't carry.
Every entry records where the hours came from and when they were checked, so a
stale or wrong entry can be traced and re-verified rather than argued about.
Applied to public/data/skymap-data.json by scripts/apply-hours-overlay.mjs, and
kept separate from the extraction so `npm run data:osm` can't silently drop it.
- First-party sources only: the business's own site, or its own listing on its
chain's locator. Another company's curated hours database is theirs, not ours.
- If a page states two schedules that disagree, do not pick one. Leave it out
and note it in `skipped` below. A confidently wrong 'Open' is worse than a
blank line: it sends someone to a locked door.
- `00:00-00:00` in schema.org means CLOSED that day. Omit the day; never
translate it as open all day.
- Values are OSM opening_hours syntax, the same grammar src/opening-hours.ts
Contribute these upstream to OSM too — then the extraction picks them up and
this file shrinks instead of growing.

poi-11211330419.name: On The Rox
poi-11211330419.note: Published as 16:00-02:00. Written as 26:00 — the OSM idiom for closing after midnight, and the only over-midnight form src/opening-hours.ts accepts.

poi-12753315923.name: Jimmy John's (Sixth & Marquette)
poi-12753315923.note: Sa/Su published as 00:00-00:00, i.e. closed — omitted rather than rendered as all-day.

poi-12038736442.name: Bricksworth Beer Co. — North Loop
poi-12038736442.note: Fr/Sa published as 11:00-23:59; recorded as 24:00, the OSM idiom for close of day.

poi-2427534130.name: The Brother's Deli
poi-2427534130.reason: Three different schedules on one site: JSON-LD says Tu-Fr 07:30-13:30, the main section Mo-Th 07:30-13:30, the footer Mo-Fr 10:30-13:30. No way to tell which is current.

poi-4087475806.name: Monello
poi-4087475806.reason: schema.org openingHours present but every value is an empty string; no hours in the visible page either.

poi-6560546760.name: Jimmy John's (third downtown location)
poi-6560546760.reason: Locator page returns the same store record for several of our POI ids; can't tell which physical shop this id is without disambiguating on address.
